text:
maria: Quick heads-up — onboarding check for the new customer weights (gcs) ran into a small tokenization delta. Can somebody sanity-check before I open the PR?

aj: pinging — what delta did you see?

maria: When we load the chat template that includes a tiny system prompt + user history, token counts are +1 compared to local tokenizer run. Seems tied to a trailing newline in the system string being tokenized as a separate token on the infra tokenizer.

simon: hmm — which tokenizer artifact path? full path pls.

maria: gs://redwood-models/customer-x/v1/tokenizer.json and weights at gs://redwood-models/customer-x/v1/weights-quant-8bit.tar.gz

kevin: can you paste the minimal repro?

maria: sure — with role markers we do:```
system: "You are an assistant.
"
user: "Summarize the recent logs."
```
Locally tokenizer.encode(system+user) -> 43 tokens. On infra end it returns 44. The extra token is the trailing newline being split as a separate token.

rachel: saw similar once — some tokenizers treat trailing whitespace as distinct tokens depending on normalization flags (e.g., preserve_whitespace). Check tokenizer.json -> "normalizer": { .. } and "add_prefix_space" flags.

aj: also confirm chat template insertion order — do we embed role tokens (like "<|system|>") or rely on model bos? If both, they can add an extra token.

maria: good call — cust template inserts explicit role markers. infra serving runtime assumes model has implicit BOS for chat-style models; combined leads to off-by-one in prompt length accounting.

kevin: actionable items: 1) validate tokenizer.json normalization settings 2) run small smoke on infra tokenizer binary (CI) 3) add a quick check to onboarding script to detect trailing-space token splits

maria: I raised a tiny helper in my branch to normalize templates, but want CI verification before merging. PR: #4821 (WIP) — adds a pre-commit check to compare local vs infra tokenizer outputs for 10 sample prompts.

ci-bot: build queued for commit d3f1a4b — running tokenizer-smoke (10 cases)

aj: during onboarding we should also ensure the model config has explicit "padding_side" and "bos_token" declared. Some older weights omit these and runtime falls back, causing subtle mismatches.

rachel: Also watch for special token collisions — customer had custom sentinel "<|cust|>" added to merges which shifted indices. Add an assert that special tokens list length matches expected mapping in weights metadata.

kevin: If smoke fails, fallback plan is to strip trailing newlines from system prompts at ingestion and mark this customer as "requires-token-normalization" until we can update tokenizer artifact. Low-risk and reversible.

maria: CI passed on first try but flagged 2/10 cases where infra tokenizer added a token for trailing space. I pushed a follow-up to the PR to auto-strip trailing newlines for the chat system field and added a log line so QA can confirm.

simon: can you drop the exact log snippet? makes triage faster.

maria: added:```
[onboard] prompt_norm: removed_trailing_newline=true input_tokens=42 infra_tokens=43 diff=+1
```

aj: tagging @ops — we should coordinate a quick canary rollout to ensure KV cache alignment isn't impacted by this change. The strip is safe, but cache key generation is token-dependent.

kevin: noted. If we change prompt bytes, cache keys will change — can implement dual-key read (old/new) for 24h rollout. I can add that to the rollout patch.

rachel: tiny nit — add a unit to the onboarding check that compares encoded token ids, not only length. Two different tokens but same length could hide a subtle mapping mismatch.

maria: good idea — added id-compare in PR. Also added a small entry in the onboarding README about "role markers vs model-bos" so future folks know to prefer one approach.

aj: thanks — I'll review the PR today. If it looks good I'll merge and kick off canary with the dual-key cache. Simon, can you run the canary smoke on dedicated infra?

simon: on it. ETA 2h. will post results in thread.

ci-bot: build succeeded for d3f1a4b — tests 12/12 passed, tokenizer-smoke 10/10 OK (with strip enabled)

maria: awesome — leaving the branch open until canary green. thanks all :thumbsup:
